contact.basis: Unchanged Copernicus surface sample at the open central approach. Elevation data are too coarse to measure the courtyard steps.

sources.method: Original Copernicus GLO-30 surface samples were bilinearly resampled in the fixed map frame. This is a coarse surface model, and no source elevations have been flattened or replaced.
